scope.summary: Provide crash-safe automatic recovery (recover unsaved changes on next launch from a configurable recovery location) and a document-states surface listing session edit states that can jump the document to any recorded state beyond linear undo. Both MUST bind to the kernel per-file history/undo model (14.19, MT-011) and CRDT authority; Studio MUST NOT implement a private undo store. Recovery + states are projections over the ledger-backed history, not a parallel store.
acceptance_criteria: auto-recovery from configurable location; document-states jump beyond linear undo; kernel-history-backed, no private store
proof_targets: crash-recovery runtime; state-jump over kernel history test
expected_tests: live: simulated crash recovers unsaved changes from configurable location on relaunch
test: document-states jump to a recorded state beyond linear undo; no private undo store (uses kernel history)

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Recovery & document states

risk_if_missed: Data loss on crash; no non-linear state navigation; forbidden private undo store risk.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
